_about: The source of this book's PDF and EPUB (scripts/build-book-files.mjs). The folder is named by the book's id, its folder under client/public/ebook/; the title and subtitle come from client/src/data/covers.json. The sec*.xhtml files are the author's text, one block to a line: taken from the original EPUB kept (untouched) in content/held-downloads/originals/, built once unchanged and verified against it, then edited at his instruction (see `edited`). The original PDF and EPUB carry the same text (compared letter by letter; the PDF adds only its running heads). Correct the text there, change `modified`, and run `node scripts/build-book-files.mjs deacon-qualifications --verify`. `copyright` is the fuller of the two notices the original files printed, without the PDF's unfilled ISBN line.
author: James Bell
